observations: TOTP must be read inside a fresh ~30s window; an edge call returns 'Invalid TOTP' (retry next window).
Dhan mint rate limit is server-side 1 per 2 minutes; local renew() enforces a 130s cooldown.
A successful generate_token() REVOKES the previous JWT server-side (single active session).
Time-based expiry checks cannot detect revocation: a revoked 'young-looking' JWT yields REST DH-906 and WS DH-901 rejections.

During P14-v1 the WS reconnect kept resending the now-revoked token (renew() only re-mints on time-expiry) -> DH-901 cycling; during P14-v2 (no rotation) reconnect succeeded (closed->disconnected->connected, recv 4->8, sub 1->2).
